name: ETDA / ThaiCERT Threat Group Cards (threat actor and tool encyclopedia)
operator: Electronic Transactions Development Agency (ETDA), ThaiCERT - Thailand
tier_rationale: Government agency running the Thai national CERT (A8 BR2: government bodies and national CERTs are trusted); P295 cond 8 lists ETDA/ThaiCERT among the trusted dataset providers.

reliability.justification: Curated encyclopedia compiled from public vendor reporting; updated infrequently (export version 20250816).

threat_group_cards.title: Threat Group Cards MISP-galaxy export (cgi-bin/getmisp.cgi?o=g groups, o=t tools) and card pages (showcard.cgi?u=<uuid>)
threat_group_cards.notes: P295 cond 1-2: ETDA publishes no licence or terms, so its class is 'unknown' (A1) until legal records it (proposed basis: runtime fetch, attribution, no redistribution). Until then the export is NOT fetched and NOT bundled: no dataset is registered and actor_alias_index does not list this source (its terms stay 'open'). The parser is ready and tested on a synthetic fixture with the real export structure. Served through Cloudflare (no challenge seen on 2026-11-26): a challenge page is BLOCKED, never bypassed (A9). Card links use ?u=<uuid> (name pivots need the full comma-joined primary name).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G11-1 (P295). Unused until legal records the terms class of threat_group_cards; see docs/backlog/p1-G11-1.md.
